name: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. Units
summary: UY Scuti Acquisition Corp. is a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), officially established on January 18, 2024, and headquartered in New York, NY. Its main objective is to execute a business combination, which may take various forms such as a merger, a capital stock exchange, an asset acquisition, a stock purchase, a corporate reorganization, or another comparable transaction involving one or more entities.
